scientificLimits: A resting mature human erythrocyte; no deformation simulation.
The ruler measures cell diameter in every pose.
Molecular sizes, spacing, colours and particle counts are enlarged or sampled illustrations.
The featured hemoglobin guide retains four C-alpha traces and four hemes from deoxygenated 2HHB; it does not depict bound oxygen.
The local window is an educational section, not an anatomical opening in a living cell.
interactionProof: continuous scale navigation enters a closed cell after a previous open specimen
legacy whole notes stay closed unless the explicit rbcWindow flag is true
center and rim observations remain closed
comparison closes the section and retains the physical ratio

exploratoryAttempts.policy: Retain raw failed geometry or test reports with their original hashes. Final pass counts are derived only from the actual final reports; exploratory failures stay visible.
